$comment: USPT supplements (Phase 006). The seed admission rules in registries/taxonomy-registry.json are used verbatim wherever they are already rule expressions; the three stated only in prose are formalised here, each citing its basis. The facet admissibility rule is the one Phase 006 §9 V-US-02 states; others are registered by domain schemes, never compiled.

facetAdmissibility.name: booking-not-durable
facetAdmissibility.statement: A booking that lasts forever is not a booking: Entitlement Form booking with Temporality durable is inadmissible.

offer.basis: Phase 006 §5: offer is-a Proposal — a distinct role carried by the Offer construct, not a facet binding

bundle.basis: Phase 006 §4.5: an exchangeable entity with PART-OF composition of at least two exchangeable entities

promotion.basis: Phase 006 §5: an offer whose consideration is modified by a policy
